description: This Java class is an implementation of a Data Access Object (DAO) for CustomerAttribute entities. It performs database queries using QueryDSL with JPQL to retrieve CustomerAttribute objects based on various criteria such as ID, option ID, customer ID, and store context.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for CustomerAttribute entity, providing methods to query customer attributes by various filters using QueryDSL.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerAttribute entity by its ID, eagerly fetching associated customer, option, and option value details.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute based on merchant store, customer ID, and option ID, with related entities fetched.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerAttribute entities associated with a specific customer and store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches CustomerAttributes that are associated with a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes matching a specific option ID within a store context.
